generation_meta_data.title: Bug Report: TypedDict Schema JSON Generation Missing Extra Behavior
generation_meta_data.description: Issue with Pydantic's JSON schema generation where `typed_dict_schema` ignores `extra` configuration when there is no `cls` parameter. The `JsonSchemaGenerator.typed_dict_schema` method only checks `config.get('extra')` but doesn't look at `schema.get('extra_behavior')` or `config.extra_fields_behavior`. This affects our pydantic-ai integration where we create schemas without cls. Workaround implemented locally but upstream fix needed.
